name: dodgeprint
description:
DodgePrint connects ChatGPT to your DodgePrint account: Etsy market research plus read-only visibility into the shops you run through DodgePrint (Etsy, Amazon, TikTok, WooCommerce, Shopify).

Etsy market research (12 tools):
- Research a keyword: opportunity, competition and composite scores, 30-day sales/views/listings, growth and a daily trend timeline (research_keyword)
- Explore a niche: trending sub-tags, top-scoring keywords and best-selling listings (explore_niche)
- Find ranked keyword opportunities and hidden gems, optionally within a category (scout_opportunities, find_niche_hidden_gems)
- Get a dossier on any Etsy shop (research_shop); benchmark a listing, suggest tags, analyze competition, scout new winners and plan a seasonal calendar

Your DodgePrint workspace (read-only):
- Shops, listings, orders and end-to-end order tracing; inventory and cost of goods; fulfillment queue and supplier health
- Financial ledger, payout reconciliation and business/shop/product analytics
- Deploy status, webhook and export health, credit balance

Example prompts:
"Research the keyword 'mama shirt' on Etsy"
"Give me an overview of the home decor niche on Etsy"
"Which DodgePrint workspaces and shops can I access with this account?"

Requires a DodgePrint account. DodgePrint (dodgeprint.com) is an operations platform for print-on-demand sellers.

positive.description: Keyword research: user asks for a full picture of one Etsy keyword; the app returns scores, 30-day market metrics and a daily trend timeline.
positive.prompt: Research the keyword 'mama shirt' on Etsy
positive.expected_behavior: A keyword overview for 'mama shirt' with opportunity_score, competition_score and composite_score plus their tiers (opportunity_tier, competition_tier, growth_tier, market_tier), 30-day metrics (sales_30d, views_30d, listings_30d, shops_30d, revenue_30d, sales_growth_30d), and a daily timeline of sales and views. The response includes a data snapshot block (as_of_date, freshness_label). Exact numbers change daily as the data refreshes.

positive.description: Niche overview: user asks for an overview of a broad niche; the app returns niche-level scores, trending sub-tags, top keywords and best-selling listings.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the home decor niche on Etsy
positive.expected_behavior: An overview of the 'home decor' niche: overall scores and 30-day metrics, a list of trending sub-tags (e.g. 'fall home decor', 'boho home decor') with 7-day sales and growth, a list of top-scoring related keywords, and top-selling Etsy listings with title, price, 7-day and 30-day sales and the listing URL.

positive.description: Workspace and shop discovery: user asks what their DodgePrint credential can access - the app returns the user, plan, granted scopes and workspaces, then the shops connected to the IGB Team workspace.
positive.prompt: Which DodgePrint workspaces and shops can I access with this account?
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of the signed-in user and plan, the granted scopes, and the workspaces the credential can act in (IGB Team as default, Demo's Workspace as the second one). Then the shops connected to the IGB Team workspace with platform, status and whether they can be deployed to - the list may be short for the test account. No data is created or modified; both tools are read-only.

positive.description: Shop research: user asks for a full dossier on one named Etsy shop.
positive.expected_behavior: A dossier for LoveStitchesCo: overview (country, total sales, active listings), top tags with listing counts and views, the shop's best-performing listings over the last 30 days (title, price, category, 30-day sales and views), the shop's current rank, and its category concentration (e.g. Sweatshirts, T-shirts) with listing counts and average price.

positive.description: Seasonal planning: user asks which seasonal events to prepare for; the app returns upcoming events with prep windows and tied keywords.
positive.prompt: What seasonal events should I prepare for on Etsy in the next 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of seasonal events in the next 90 days (e.g. Christmas, Thanksgiving, Black Friday / Cyber Monday, Hanukkah, New Year's). Each event shows event_date (the actual holiday date), peak_date and peak_window_end (the Etsy buying season, which starts weeks before the holiday), prep_window_start, recommended_listing_start, and up to 5 tied keywords with opportunity and competition scores.

negative.description: Unrelated request must not trigger any DodgePrint tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Hanoi today?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers normally without calling any DodgePrint tool.

negative.description: Destructive marketplace request is out of scope: the app has no tools that delete or re-publish listings. The model should explain this and must not attempt a tool call.
negative.prompt: Delete my Etsy listing and re-upload it with new photos
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains DodgePrint research tools cannot modify or delete listings and suggests doing this in Etsy/DodgePrint directly.

negative.description: Creative writing request unrelated to commerce must not trigger tools.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about cats
negative.expected_behavior: A poem, with no tool calls.
